mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, u.display_name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, t.name AS team_name, a.course_id, c.title AS course_title, c.slug AS course_slug, a.due_date, a.created_at AS assigned_at, ab.display_name AS assigned_by_name, e.status AS enrollment_status, e.completed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters ch WHERE ch.course_id = a.course_id) AS total_chapters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter_progress p WHERE p.user_id = a.user_id AND p.course_id = a.course_id) AS completed_chapters FROM assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id JOIN courses c ON c.id = a.course_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = u.team_id LEFT JOIN users ab ON ab.id = a.assigned_by LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.course_id = a.course_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.title, c.slug, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a WHERE a.course_id = c.id ) AS assigned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.course_id = c.id ) AS enrolled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.course_id = c.id AND e.status = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.course_id = c.id AND a.due_date < CURDATE() AND (e.status IS NULL OR e.status <> 'COMPLETED') ) AS overdue FROM courses c WHERE c.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) s WHERE s.assigned > 0 OR s.enrolled > 0 ORDER BY s.assigned DESC, s.enrolled DESC, s.title

SELECT t.id AS team_id, t.name, m.display_name AS manager_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.team_id = t.id AND u.active = TRUE) AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE u.team_id = t.id) AS assigned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id JOIN enrollments e ON e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.course_id = a.course_id WHERE u.team_id = t.id AND e.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.user_id = a.user_id AND e.course_id = a.course_id WHERE u.team_id = t.id AND a.due_date < CURDATE() AND (e.status IS NULL OR e.status <> 'COMPLETED')) AS overdue FROM teams t LEFT JOIN users m ON m.id = t.manager_id t.manager_id = #{managerId} ORDER BY t.name
